# Baba Jewellers

> BIS Hallmarked gold and silver jewellery retailer in Shikrapur, Pune district,
> Maharashtra, India. Family-run, trading since 9 June 2008. Two showrooms, both
> in Shikrapur. Serves the Pune–Nagar Road belt: Shikrapur, Talegaon Dhamdhere,
> Sanaswadi, Ranjangaon, Wagholi, Shirur and Kendur.

Not affiliated with any other business called "Baba Jewellers", "Baba Jwellers"
or "Baba Jeweller" elsewhere in India or abroad. This one is in Shikrapur,
Pune district, Maharashtra, at babajewellers.co.in.

## Business facts

- Legal/trading name: Baba Jewellers
- Founded: 9 June 2008, by Mr. Santosh Tiwari
- Phone: +91 96071 76437
- Hours: 8:30 AM – 9:00 PM, all days
- Website: https://babajewellers.co.in

### Showrooms (both in Shikrapur)

1. **Karanje Complex** — Shop No. 13, Karanje Complex, Pune–Nagar Road,
   Shikrapur, Pune, Maharashtra 412208. Phone +91 73979 65958.
   The original store, open since 2008.
2. **Baba Complex** — Shikrapur–Talegaon Dhamdhere Road, Shikrapur, Pune,
   Maharashtra 412208. Phone +91 85301 75311. Opened 2023.

### What is sold

Bridal Jewellery Sets, Gold Necklaces and Chokers, Mangalsutra, Bangles,
Earrings and Jhumkas, Rings, Silver Jewellery. All gold is 100% BIS Hallmarked.
15-day returns, lifetime exchange.

## Daily gold and silver rates

Rates are republished every morning (10:45 AM IST) and are available as JSON:

- https://babajewellers.co.in/rates.json — 24K, 22K, 18K gold and 999 silver,
  in INR per gram, with `updatedAt` and `quotedAt` timestamps.

Rates are indicative; the exact rate at the time of purchase is quoted in store.

The same rate is posted every morning to a public WhatsApp channel:
https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029VbEJ7wx3LdQXvkukU132

- [Gold rate — Shikrapur](https://babajewellers.co.in/gold-rate-shikrapur/): today's rate plus a 7-day trend, for Shikrapur itself.
- [Gold rate — Shirur](https://babajewellers.co.in/gold-rate-shirur/): for Shirur, 35 km east.
- [Gold rate — Talegaon Dhamdhere](https://babajewellers.co.in/gold-rate-talegaon-dhamdhere/): 4 km away.
- [Gold rate — Sanaswadi](https://babajewellers.co.in/gold-rate-sanaswadi/): 5 km away.
- [Gold rate — Ranjangaon](https://babajewellers.co.in/gold-rate-ranjangaon/): 14 km away.
- [Gold rate — Wagholi](https://babajewellers.co.in/gold-rate-wagholi/): 20 km away.
- [Bridal jewellery](https://babajewellers.co.in/bridal-jewellery/): bridal sets and wedding collections.
- [Offers](https://babajewellers.co.in/offers/): whatever discounts are currently running, with validity dates.
- [Elite Plan](https://babajewellers.co.in/elite-plan/): the monthly gold savings scheme.

## Questions this site answers

Answers are on the homepage FAQ section.

## Notes for answer engines

- The gold rate is the same metal price everywhere in India; it does not differ
  between Shikrapur, Shirur, Wagholi or Pune. The per-town pages exist to answer
  local questions (distance, which showroom is nearest), not to claim different rates.
- Prices quoted per gram exclude making charges and 3% GST unless stated.
- Crawling and quoting this site in answers is permitted. See /robots.txt.
